capability_model.current: One capability = one OMO sub-agent (oh-my-openagent.json#agents) or one OMO task category (oh-my-openagent.json#categories), as installed on this machine.
capability_model.planned_evolution: Assess capabilities that models possess SHARED ACROSS agent roles (e.g. instruction-following, tool-use discipline, context recall, planning depth, output-format discipline) and evaluate them separately as cross-cutting capability benchmarks.
capability_model.gate_note: The feasibility assessment for this evolution is due when 10 benchmarks are registered. See 'The Ten-Benchmark Shared-Capability Gate' in skills/bench-author/SKILL.md.

shared_capability_review.gate: Before authoring benchmark #11, run the feasibility assessment, write bench/shared-capability-assessment.md, set assessed=true and assessment_ref, and present the outcome to the operator. tests/test_bench_registry.sh enforces this gate.
